title: Victory!
description: Defeat the Rabbit and save Folderton

story: Brilliant! You saved all the villagers!
You are alone with the Rabbit and the bell.
The Rabbit turns angrily and starts running towards you.
Eleanor: "Quick! Remove the bell!"
hints: Use 'rm bell' to remove the bell.

story: The rabbit stops. The anger behind its eyes fades, replaced with confusion.
The Swordmaster runs into the rabbithole.
Swordmaster: "You did it! The rabbit is free from the cursed bell!"
"You saved everyone!"
"Have you looked inside the chest the rabbit stole? It's right here."
hints: Use 'cat chest/scroll' to examine the contents.

story: The scroll describes a powerful command: 'sudo'
NEW POWER: Use 'sudo' to make yourself into a Super User!
Swordmaster: "Try it out. Use 'sudo ls' to look around."
"This command gives you the power to do things when all else fails."
hints: Use 'sudo ls' to test the new power.

story: Swordmaster: "Wow, you have some skills!"
"You became a Super User for an instant!"
"Knowing this command gives you tremendous power."
"You should turn into a Super User and remove this chest"
"so it cannot fall into enemy hands again."
"To delete the whole chest, use: sudo rm -r chest"
"The -r flag is used for directories."
hints: Use 'sudo rm -r chest' to remove the chest and its contents.

story: Swordmaster: "Well done!"
"Let's go back to ~/town. Everyone will want to thank you!"
hints: Use 'cd ~/town' to go back to town.

story: The townspeople cheer as you walk into town!
Eleanor: "Look around at everyone!"
You see your Mum, Dad, and everyone else you met on your adventure!
They stand around you clapping and cheering.
Mum: "You saved Folderton! You're a hero!"
Dad: "I'm so proud of you!"
Mayor: "Remember: With great power comes great responsibility."
Eleanor: "You found my parents! Thank you for everything!"
Swordmaster: "You've done well. Keep training and you'll become even more powerful."
Congratulations! You've completed Terminal Trail!
You've learned essential Linux commands:
ls, cd, cat, pwd, mkdir, echo, mv, rm, vi, chmod, ls -l, sudo
You now have the skills to navigate and control a Linux system.
Keep practicing and exploring!
Thank you for playing Terminal Trail!
hints: Use echo to celebrate your victory!
